# Pinned test dependencies — MINIMUM supported Home Assistant.
#
# Must match "homeassistant" in hacs.json; the same minimum Roomba+ uses. Kept
# out of the repository root on purpose: Dependabot would otherwise "upgrade"
# the minimum away.
#
# Python: Home Assistant 2025.5 runs on Python 3.13.

pytest-homeassistant-custom-component==0.13.245  # homeassistant==2025.5.2

# pycares IS PINNED, and only here. HA 2025.5.2 requires aiodns==3.4.0, which
# allows any pycares>=4.0.0 but names `pycares.ares_query_a_result` at import
# time — removed in pycares 5.0.0. Without this pin a fresh install fails with
# AttributeError on `import aiohttp`, before a single test is collected
# (verified). Newer HA versions pin an aiodns that supports pycares 5.
pycares==4.11.0

# The integration's runtime SNMP dependency (mirrors manifest.json).
puresnmp==2.0.1
